assets.name: spade
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Premium original Ace emblem for the TEKAD Big Two playing card deck, raster PNG.
Primary request: Exactly ONE classic SPADE playing-card suit emblem. A broad pointed leaf rising to one sharp top apex, two rounded lower shoulders, and one short broad stem centered below.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, empty outside the single silhouette.
Style/medium: bold geometric flat screenprint, black enamel-like solid ink fill, restrained antique gold botanical engraving INSIDE silhouette only. A few warm ivory fine-line engraved details. Mostly solid color, excellent readability at 45 to 70px. Elegant original royal deck ornament.
Composition/framing: centered symmetrical emblem on square canvas occupying 85 percent of available width/height with at least 7 percent safe transparent margin. Clean continuous unmistakable suit outer contour.
Constraints: one single suit only. No external flourishes. No cards, frames, letters, words, numbers, text, crowns, other suit symbols, jewels, photorealism, drop shadow, gradients or scene. Minimal broad internal engraved botanical stems and leaves; generous uninterrupted solid fill. All decoration stays well inside the silhouette.

assets.refinementPrompt: Edit target: the diamond Ace emblem. Correct only its OUTER silhouette into a geometrically straight-sided rhombus: exactly four perfectly STRAIGHT sides joining four sharp points, top (50%,7%), right (85%,50%), bottom (50%,93%), left (15%,50%). NO curved or concave sides. Keep deep crimson solid fill, antique gold and ivory botanical ornament inside this outline, same original premium flat screenprint style. Preserve transparent background. No text, card, frames, extra symbols or external flourishes. Square canvas. This must read immediately as the standard DIAMOND playing-card suit. All side edges must be perfectly straight, like a rotated square stretched vertically.

prompts.limitations: Full heads are in frame, margins closer to 3–5% than requested 8%. All five outputs have true RGBA alpha: corners and top-background samples alpha0. Image viewer showed RGB under alpha; colored glows in underlying RGB should not be mistaken for opaque background.

prompts.correction_prompt: Edit this character cut-in: preserve identity, expression, drawing style, colors and clothing. Remove ALL background including black field, colored glow and shadow; output real transparent alpha background with a clean cutout edge. Reframe by zooming OUT 20% so the COMPLETE top and sides of the hair or hijab are visible, with at least 100 pixels of empty transparent space above the highest hair/hijab point and 120 pixels at left and right. Reconstruct clipped hair/hijab so the top silhouette is complete. Keep same 1536x1024 landscape canvas. Head and shoulders only, chest cropped at bottom; no hands, no extra objects. This is a isolated transparent character portrait sprite, not a finished banner. Absolutely no background, gradient or glow.
